nodes.id: Huanglong Scenic and Historic Interest Area
nodes.summary: Huanglong is a scenic and historic interest area in the northwest part of Sichuan, China. It is located in the southern part of the Minshan mountain range, 370 kilometres (230 mi) north-northwest of the capital Chengdu. This area is known for its colorful travertine pools formed by calcite deposits, especially in Huanglonggou, as well as diverse forest ecosystems, snow-capped peaks, waterfalls and hot springs. Huanglong is also home to many endangered species including the giant panda and the Sichuan golden snub-nosed monkey. In addition, a large population of the endemic orchid species Cypripedium plectrochilum was discovered at the site. nodes.summary: Sichuan is an inland province in Southwestern China. It is located in the Sichuan Basin and Tibetan Plateau—between the Jinsha River to the west, the Daba Mountains to the north, and the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau to the south. Its capital city is Chengdu, and the province's population stands at 83 million. Sichuan neighbors Qinghai and Gansu to the north, Shaanxi and Chongqing to the east, Guizhou and Yunnan to the south, and Tibet to the west.

Jiangsu is a coastal province in East China. It is one of the leading provinces in finance, education, technology, and tourism, with its capital in Nanjing. Jiangsu is the third smallest, but the fourth most populous, with a population of 84.75 million, and the most densely populated of the 22 provinces of the People's Republic of China. Jiangsu has the highest GDP per capita and second-highest GDP of Chinese provinces, after Guangdong. Jiangsu borders Shandong in the north, Anhui to the west, and Zhejiang and Shanghai to the south. Jiangsu has a coastline of over 1,000 kilometers (620 mi) along the Yellow Sea, and the Yangtze flows through the southern part of the province.

nodes.summary: Luminiferous aether or ether is the formerly postulated medium for the propagation of light. It was invoked to explain the ability of the apparently wave-based light to propagate through empty space, something that waves should not be able to do. The assumption of a spatial plenum of luminiferous aether, rather than a spatial vacuum, provided the theoretical medium that was required by wave theories of light.

nodes.summary: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs is one of the governing bodies of Huanglong. A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by a Supervisor. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.

nodes.summary: The Port City of Guixu was a former settlement located on the western coast of Outer Huanglong. Hundreds of years ago, it hosted the world's tallest building. The Incinero Petal Toxin from the Sea of Flames caused the destruction and mass evacuation of the city. Before the Lament descended upon the city, leaving nothing but ruin, Guixu had an outdoor music venue at Nostalgia Isle, as well as a record shop within the city. Its remains now float in the air with a menacing black hole behind it, reminding all of Jinzhou what came before.

nodes.summary: "The Lament" (Chinese: 悲鸣, "lament" or "wail of sorrow") is a term used to describe a series of catastrophic mass-extinction phenomena that have affected the planet Solaris-3, and is one of the primary driving narratives in Wuthering Waves. It serves as the general classification for all major disaster trends and Waveworn Phenomena observed on the planet. Over the past 10,000 years, five global Lament events and more than 300,000 regional instances have been recorded, indicating a recurring and persistent pattern of large-scale disruption. These events have led to the emergence of individuals known as Resonators—those who have adapted to, or been shaped by, the residual energy of the Lament.

They were created by the Homeland Civilization, whose Exostriders would deliver them to Solaris-3.

nodes.summary: Ashinohara was a nation in Solaris-3, a solitary floating island walled in on all sides, that was largely destroyed by the Lament. It was the former site of Honami City, where the site of Neo Honami City was built nearby after the city's disappearance. The entire country recently vanished in a single day.
etymology: The name "Ashinohara" is derived from "Ashihara-no-Nakatsukuni" , the world between Takamagahara (heaven) and Yomi (hell) in Japanese mythology. It is also used as a poetic name for Japan.

nodes.summary: The Fractsidus 残星会 is a mysterious global terrorist organization that serves as the main antagonistic faction of Wuthering Waves. Their aim is to accelerate the next Lament - dubbed the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians, viewing the Lament not as an apocalyptic catastrophe but as a sign of necessary evolution for humanity. They have caused attacks of various scales across the world in their quest for absolute power and a distorted sense of Resonance Equality.
etymology: Fractsidus is derived from the Latin frāctus, ancestor of English "fracture," and sīdus. This is reflected in the Asian names for the Fractsidus, "broken star society."

A giant, overlying Soliskin root network in Bjartr Woods discovered by the Spacetrek Collective has expelled Aleph-1's power beyond the Stridergate, forming a sealed gateway that currently prevents the Threnodian's return.

It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.

nodes.summary: The Xuanfang Wardens are the primary military force of the frontier region of Xuanfang within the province of Mengzhou. They stand as the final bulwark protecting the Hold, alongside the Autopuppets. Legally, their power is derived from the Ministry of War established by Mengzhou City Hall. Among their ranks serve the Xuan Watchers, an elite formation forged to confront only the most formidable Tacet Discords. The Wardens and the Xuan Triad are led by Warden Commander Qiuhong.

In Roman mythology, Romulus and Remus are twin brothers whose story tells of the events that led to the founding of the city of Rome and the Roman Kingdom by Romulus, following his fratricide of Remus. The image of a she-wolf suckling the twins in their infancy has been a symbol of the city of Rome and the ancient Romans since at least the 3rd century BC. Although the tale takes place before the founding of Rome in 753 BC, the earliest known written account of the myth is from the late 3rd century BC. Possible historical bases for the story, and interpretations of its local variants, are subjects of ongoing debate.

nodes.summary: The Pre-Lament Civilization (PLC) was Solaris' native civilisation before the destruction wrought by the Lament. It was capable of spacetravel, having sent thousands of satellites and nine interstellar probes, including The Farwatcher, into the darkness of space - these nine probes represented by the stars in the emblem of the Spacetrek Collective. The PLC's cities and machinery were powered by electricity; electric-powered devices, such as Jinzhou's Disruptor, are rarer in the present. The Lament destroyed 80% of their structures and killed half the global population.

Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. It is also the city with the strongest link to the Sentinel, thus the Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, Imperator, and believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will.

nodes.summary: Throughout Rinascita, she is revered as Fleurdelys, the "Blessed Maiden," and in some accounts, "The Martyred Maiden." As a key figure in the region’s history, she holds profound influence, with her connections to the Sentinel Imperator, the Threnodian Leviathan, and the Dark Tide. Her true desires, however, lie in freeing herself from the shackles of her titles and living out her days as a just and righteous wandering knight.
etymology: Fleur-de-lys (more commonly spelt fleur-de-lis) is a common type of stylized heraldic charge shaped like a lily flower, described as "at one and the same time, religious, political, dynastic, artistic, emblematic, and symbolic".
Fleur-de-lis (lit. "flower of lily") is a French word; the name itself derives from ancient Greek λείριον > Latin lilium > French lis.

nodes.summary: Rinascita is one of the nations located on Solaris-3, and the second nation visited by Rover. It is comprised of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago deep in the Stormy Sea, with no single administrative center. Although the city-states do not share a single political entity, they share a common history, origin as wanderers across the oceans, and the protection of the Sentinel Imperator.

nodes.summary: Blade Runner is a 1982 science fiction film directed by Ridley Scott from a screenplay by Hampton Fancher and David Peoples. Starring Harrison Ford, Rutger Hauer, Sean Young, and Edward James Olmos, it is an adaptation of the 1968 novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? by Philip K. Dick. The film is set in a dystopian future Los Angeles of 2019, in which synthetic humans known as replicants are bio-engineered by the powerful Tyrell Corporation to work on space colonies. When a fugitive group of advanced replicants led by Roy Batty (Hauer) escapes back to Earth, former cop Rick Deckard (Ford) is recalled to hunt them down.

Neo Honami City was the capital of Ashinohara. It was the surviving portion of Honami City that was left intact after it was sealed away within a Sonoro Sphere during a Lament. Up until recently, the city endured as a metropolis in the nation until the country's mysterious disappearance, where Ashinohara vanished from Solaris-3 in a single day. The whereabouts of the metropolis following the disappearance of the country remain unknown.

The Heliodic Six is a group of six Roya Tribe members known to have great mathematical and calculation skills. They act as the sense for the Heliogyre located in Solisylum. People from the tribe rarely see the members because they remain inside the Solisylum most of the time, and access is highly restricted.

nodes.summary: The Twenty-Eight Mansions, also called xiu or hsiu, are part of the Chinese constellations system. They can be considered as the equivalent to the zodiacal constellations in Western astronomy, though the Twenty-eight Mansions reflect the movement of the Moon through a sidereal month rather than the Sun in a tropical year. Each mansion is roughly a day of the month.

nodes.summary: According to ancient and medieval science, aether, also known as the fifth element or quintessence, is the material that fills the region of the universe beyond the terrestrial sphere. The concept of aether was used in several theories to explain several natural phenomena, such as the propagation of light and gravity. In the late 19th century, physicists postulated that aether permeated space, providing a medium through which light could travel in a vacuum, but evidence for the presence of such a medium was not found in the Michelson–Morley experiment, and this result has been interpreted to mean that no luminiferous aether exists.

nodes.summary: Lahai-Roi is a region located on Solaris-3, visited by Rover in Chapter III: To the Stars Yet to Shine. It is a warm and humid region located at one of Solaris' poles under the Roya Frostlands, after ancient planetary shifts during the first Global Lament transformed the once-lush forests at the surface into a region covered in snow most of the year that is now sparsely populated. After the second Global Lament, where the massive mecha Exostrider and Threnodian Aleph-1 descended through the Stridergate, the displaced native Roya Tribe were guided to move their major settlements underground in the aftermath.
etymology: The name Lahai-Roi is likely derived from Beer-lahai-roi , a well mentioned in the Book of Genesis. When used on its own, Lahai-Roi corresponds to the Hebrew phrase la-ḥai ro’i , sometimes rendered more generally as “the Living One who sees.”

nodes.summary: Dimmr Plains is in the deepest depths of Lahai-Roi, the final resting place before the Stridergate and the insanity of Voidspace. It contains the great Solvein Heartwood and Keystone, which serves as a seal on the Threnodian Aleph-1 preventing it from entering Solaris-3. nodes.summary: The Italian wolf, also known as the Apennine wolf, is a subspecies of the grey wolf native to the Italian Peninsula. nodes.summary: The Court of Savantae 稷廷 is a research organization with various laboratories scattered across Solaris. It was at the cutting edge of research into the Lament and related phenomena since the original lament 10,000 years ago. While the ruins in Whining Aix's Mire were used by a group of exiled researchers and do not necessarily represent the whole organisation, the Court's living membership appears to have been disbanded by the present day. However, it is known they were active as little as two hundred years ago.
etymology: The Court's name in Chinese means court or government office of millet/grain. This provides an interesting link to the Hé civilisation, whose name is also connected to grain.

While at first appearing Latin, savantae is not actually a word in the language. German's use of Gelehrten (scholars) suggests it may be intended as "Court of Savants," although it may be an intentional corruption of sapientae, which is the actual ancestor of savant.

etymology: Huánglóng is the sound of tinkling jade.
The 𤣩 radical represents jade-related words. Lóng is "sound of tinkling jade", or "a jade with dragon design used to pray for rain".
Without the 𤣩 radical, Huáng is "king", and Lóng is "dragon".
Huánglóng is "Yellow dragon".

The Montelli Family is a family-run organization and enterprise native to Rinascita, localized primarily in the city-state of Ragunna. They are considered one of the families that influence the power dynamics of Ragunna, alongside the Fisalia Family and the Order of the Deep. As of Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, it was revealed that the Montelli Family has sent an invitation to Rover to attend Rinascita's Carnevale via their outside connections with the Black Shores. They are recognized as the rivals of the Fisalia Family.

nodes.summary: Zhejiang is a coastal province in East China. Its capital and largest city is Hangzhou, with other notable cities including Ningbo, Yiwu and Wenzhou. Zhejiang is bordered by Jiangsu and Shanghai to the north, Anhui to the northwest, Jiangxi to the west and Fujian to the south. To the east is the East China Sea, beyond which lies the Ryukyu Islands. The population of Zhejiang stands at 64.6 million, the 8th largest in China. It is a major driving force in the Chinese economy and the birthplace of several notable people, including the Chinese Nationalist leader Chiang Kai-shek and entrepreneur Jack Ma. Zhejiang consists of 90 counties.

Saturn was a god in ancient Roman religion, and a character in Roman mythology. He was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation. Saturn's mythological reign was depicted as a Golden Age of abundance and peace. After the Roman conquest of Greece, he was conflated with the Greek Titan Cronus. Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

The Roya Tribe are the indigenous people of Lahai-Roi. They inhabited the country before the planetary shifts occurred which froze the surface, causing them to relocate underground. They built the Solisylum and consider it their calling to guide the growth and migration of Exoswarm by using a calendar created after observing the behaviour of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive.
etymology: Roya is likely derived from ru'yā / ro'yâ , borrowed from ruʔyā

nodes.summary: The Internal Security Agency, or ISA, is an institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong. Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.

nodes.summary: The Homeland Civilization, or Rover's Civilization, is the far-away motherland of Rover and a space-faring civilization. It created the Exostriders and Sentinels to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the Threnodians. They sent Rover on their mission to defeat the Lament, created the mysterious communications satellite swallowed by Aleph-1, and cut off Rover after they begged to be allowed home. It is unknown if the civilisation is unwilling or unable to re-establish contact with Solaris.

etymology: Lupa is a Latin word meaning "she-wolf", which is a term for a female wolf.

The She-wolf was an Italian wolf from ancient Roman mythology, who was said to have nursed and parented the twins Romulus and Remus after they were abandoned in the wild. The twins would later become the founders of Rome, with Romulus becoming its first king.
The binomial name for wolves is "canis lupus".

nodes.summary: Septimont is a Region and city-state of Rinascita. Unlike Ragunna, Septimont has a far more militant and irreligious culture, as it places far less importance on the primacy of the Sentinel Imperator and instead worships the Lioness of Glory Arsinosa. As a result, the Agons, competitive gladiatorial combat, are the pinnacle of Septimontese society and can even determine the makeup of the political establishment. The Order of the Deep holds little power in Septimont, with most locals uninterested or even hostile to their message of salvation.
etymology: Septimont is derived from Latin septem montes, meaning “seven mountains” or “seven hills.” The name references Rome, traditionally known as the city of the Seven Hills.

nodes.summary: Sparta was a prominent ancient Greek polis in Laconia. In classical antiquity, the state was known as Lacedaemon, while Sparta referred to its capital, a group of villages in the valley of the Evrotas River in Laconia, in the southeastern Peloponnese. During the 7th century BC, it rose to become the most prominent land military power in the Greek world, a status it retained until its defeat at Leuctra in 371 BC.

nodes.summary: In the Roman foundation myth, the she-wolf was an Italian wolf who nursed and sheltered the twins Romulus and Remus after they were abandoned in the wild by decree of King Amulius of Alba Longa. She cared for the infants at her den, a cave known as the Lupercal, until they were discovered by a shepherd, Faustulus. Romulus would later become the founder and first king of Rome and both twins became famous throughout history as the founders of the Rome known today. The image of the she-wolf suckling the twins has been a symbol of Rome since ancient times and is one of the most recognizable icons of ancient mythology.

nodes.summary: The dark forest hypothesis is the idea that extraterrestrial civilizations may exist in abundance across the universe, but remain silent and hidden out of fear that revealing themselves would lead to destruction by a more technologically advanced and hostile civilization. It is one of several proposed explanations of the Fermi paradox, which contrasts the apparently high probability of extraterrestrial life with the lack of evidence for it. The hypothesis derives its name from Liu Cixin's 2008 novel The Dark Forest although similar concepts predate the work.

nodes.summary: For most of its history, the ancient Greek city-state of Sparta in the Peloponnese was ruled by kings. Sparta was unusual among the Greek city-states in that it maintained its kingship past the Archaic age. It was even more unusual in that it had two kings simultaneously, who were called the archagetai, coming from two separate lines. According to tradition, the two lines, the Agiads and Eurypontids, were respectively descended from the twins Eurysthenes and Procles, the descendants of Heracles, who supposedly conquered Sparta two generations after the Trojan War. The dynasties themselves, however, were named after the twins' grandsons, the kings Agis I and Eurypon, respectively. The Agiad line was regarded as being senior to the Eurypontid line.

nodes.summary: The wolf, also known as the grey wolf or gray wolf, is a canine native to Eurasia and North America. More than thirty subspecies of Canis lupus have been recognized, including the dog and dingo, though grey wolves, as popularly understood, include only naturally occurring wild subspecies. The wolf is the largest wild extant member of the family Canidae, and is further distinguished from other Canis species by its less pointed ears and muzzle, as well as a shorter torso and a longer tail. The wolf is nonetheless related closely enough to smaller Canis species, such as the coyote and the golden jackal, to produce fertile hybrids with them. The wolf's fur is usually mottled white, brown, grey, and black, although subspecies in the Arctic region may be nearly all white.

It is a secluded region located in the southeastern seas of Jinzhou. It is historically significant as the ancestral home of Jinzhou's original settlers and the birthplace of the Magistrate and Sentinel Resonator, Jinhsi. The region is defined by unique temporal properties. Due to the influence of Sentinel Jué’s Temporal Mandate—originally implemented as a defensive measure against Tacet Discords—the passage of time on the mountain diverges from the standard timeline of the outside world. nodes.summary: A Molniya orbit is a type of satellite orbit designed to provide communications and remote sensing coverage over high latitudes. It is a highly elliptical orbit with an inclination of 63.4 degrees, an argument of perigee of 270 degrees, and an orbital period of about half a sidereal day. The name comes from the Molniya satellites, a series of Soviet/Russian civilian and military communications satellites that have used this type of orbit since the mid-1960s. A variation on the Molniya orbit is the Three Apogee orbit.

etymology: "Phrolova" is a stylized spelling of "Frolova" (Фролова), a common Russian surname (the feminine form of Frolov). The use of the Greek digraph "Ph" instead of "F" is an aesthetic choice by the developers.

The surname is derived from the Russian given name "Frol" (Фрол), which is a colloquial form of the ancient baptismal name "Flor" (Флор). This name originates from the Latin word florus, meaning "blooming", "flowering", or "bright" (from flos, meaning flower).
The suffix "-ova" is a Russian possessive ending, historically meaning "belonging to" or "daughter/wife of Frolov."

nodes.summary: Lycoris radiata, known as the red spider lily, red magic lily, corpse flower, or equinox flower, is a plant in the amaryllis family, Amaryllidaceae, subfamily Amaryllidoideae. It is originally from China, Japan, Korea and Nepal and spread from there to the United States and elsewhere. It is considered naturalized in Seychelles and in the Ryukyu Islands. It flowers in the late summer or autumn, often in response to heavy rainfall. The common name hurricane lily refers to this characteristic, as do other common names, such as resurrection lily; these may be used for the genus as a whole.

inspired.text: Aemeath (or Aemeth) is derived from the Sigillum Dei Aemeth, a magical diagram used for angelic communication. Its name means "seal of God" or "seal of truth", and ties her into the angelic elements of her character design and connects her to Sigillum.

The She-wolf was an Italian wolf from ancient Roman mythology, who was said to have nursed and parented the twins Romulus and Remus after they were abandoned in the wild. The twins would later become the founders of Rome, with Romulus becoming its first king.

Rinascita was known as "Sepunia" in CBT1. It was likely named after the obscure Sepunia plebian family of ancient Rome, who are known from inscriptions and as municipal officers of towns in Latium, Samnium, and Campania in the core of the polity.
"Rinascita" is an Italian word that means "rebirth". It is related to words meaning "to be born again" , which is also used in a religious context; and Renaissance .

The name Lahai-Roi is likely derived from Beer-lahai-roi , a well mentioned in the Book of Genesis. When used on its own, Lahai-Roi corresponds to the Hebrew phrase la-ḥai ro’i , sometimes rendered more generally as “the Living One who sees.”

inspired.text: Solaris-3 is named in a fashion similar to many classic scifi planets, using the star name (Solaris) plus a number representing the distance from said star. This differs from the naming scheme of real exoplanets such as Proxima b, where they receive lowercase letters in order of discovery.
Mt. Firmament is based on the province of Zhejiang, near Shanghai.
Mingting may be based on Beijing. Qiuyuan describes a drink which resembles douzhi, traditional in Beijing cuisine.
Mengzhou may be based on Hubei, in central China.

Aside from succession via gladitorial kratocracy, Septimont's system of government somewhat resembles that of ancient Sparta, with the Ephor and Priestess of Septimont advised by a Council of Elders bearing similarities to the Two Kings of Sparta who are in turn advised, ironically, by five individuals holding the title of Ephor, though the Elders are more akin to the Gerousia. Though, unlike the Spartan Ephors and Gerousia, the Septimont Council of Elders have no judicial authority over the Ephor and Priestess.

According to Fang Yizhi, Suan'ni are one of the Nine sons of the dragon, a set of mythological creatures whose imagery is used in certain types of decorations. Suan'ni are associated with incense burners and are fond of smoke and fire. They are often lion-like, sometimes with manes of fire or bodies of dragons.

Aleph-1 and the The White Tower's extraterrestrial origins may suggest that Threnodians are a cosmological phenomenon that exist across the wider universe at large, contrasting with Solaris-3's contemporary understandings of the Lament. This is reminiscent of the Dark Forest hypothesis, a branch of the Fermi paradox that theorizes that the lack of evidence for extraterrestrial life and humanity's apparent loneliness may be due to other civilizations being assailed by hostile forces throughout the universe, and that those that communicate become visible targets.

Aether, also written ether, was the element in medieval science which filled the cosmos beyond Earth. Modern scientists would later use the concept as luminiferous aether to explain how light could move through what appeared to be empty vacuum. It was refuted by experiment in the late 19th century.
